summary: xAI announced that Grok 4.5 is now available as a selectable model within GitHub Copilot (VSCode, cloud agents, Copilot CLI), alongside direct API access at $2/$6 per million input/output tokens.

mechanisms.reason: Distribution of Grok 4.5 into a widely used developer surface like GitHub Copilot expands the pool of users who can generate inference calls on the model.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.5 is now available in GitHub Copilot for millions of developers who use VSCode and GitHub products every day.

practices.reason: Teams using GitHub Copilot can now select Grok 4.5 from the model picker, or must enable it via settings for some enterprise accounts, which is a small interface change to note but not urgent work.
practices.quote: From the model picker, simply pick "Grok 4.5" to start using our latest coding model. For some businesses and enterprises, you will need to enable the model from Copilot settings.
